sub_sector.value: Stock and editorial imagery licensing; custom imagery

service_category.detail: Licenses stock photos, videos and editorial imagery, offers AI image generation, and secures commercial usage rights.

engagement_model.detail: Clients buy single downloads or UltraPacks, subscribe to Creative image plans, or commission original imagery and exclusive event coverage.

labor_specialization.detail: Photographers, directors and other visual creators produce library content and commissioned imagery.

client_segment.detail: Brands and businesses license imagery for campaigns and ongoing content needs.

notes: The small-business segment is inferred from self-serve purchasing options alongside enterprise pricing.
